jobs.title: Consultant, Patient Experience
jobs.description: At Qualtrics , we create software the world’s best brands use to deliver exceptional frontline experiences, build high-performing teams, and design products people love. But we are more than a platform—we are the creators and stewards of the Experience Management category serving over 18K clients globally. Building a category takes grit, determination, and a disdain for convention—but most of all it requires close-knit, high-functioning teams with an unwavering dedication to serving our customers. When you join one of our teams, you’ll be part of a nimble group that’s empowered to set aggressive goals and move fast to achieve them. Strategic risks are encouraged and complex problems are solved together, by passing the mic and iterating until the best solution comes to light. You won’t have to look to find growth opportunities—ready or not, they’ll find you. From retail to government to healthcare, we’re on a mission to bring humanity, connection, and empathy back to business. Join over 5,000 people across the globe who think that’s work worth doing. Consultant, Patient Experience Why We Have This Role Patient experience directly drives overall healthcare quality, provider engagement, and operational success. In this role, you will help healthcare organizations transform their patient experience strategy by translating data into actionable insights and high-impact improvement initiatives. Working alongside C-suite executives, healthcare providers, and our internal Strategic Consulting practice, you will lead high-impact client engagements that drive measurable results. If you are passionate about applying strategic consulting principles to solve complex challenges in healthcare, this role gives you the platform to make a lasting difference. jobs.title: Inpatient Coder Associate, Payment Integrity
jobs.description: The Payment Integrity team is a group of innovative thinkers sitting at the intersection of Clover's provider Network, Claims, and Tech teams. The Payment Integrity team ensures that Clover pays claims in an accurate manner, with a particular focus on reducing inappropriate medical spend. As an Inpatient Clinical Coder at Clover Health , you will play a key role ensuring that Clover is able to continue to build and scale a compliant, efficient and profitable program. You will work to ensure quality assurance standards and regulatory policy are reflected in claims processing practices. You will help drive value for every member by ensuring that Clover’s medical claims are paid accurately and recovering overpayments when they are identified. The Associate - Inpatient Coder coordinates the identification of provider DRG denials and upcoding. As an Inpatient Clinical Coder, you will: Partner with Clinical, Claims, and Payment Integrity peers to review claims for DRG related issues on a prospective and retrospective basis that drive inaccurate payments to providers. Proactively identify overpayments to ensure accurate claims payments on inpatient services. Participate in collaborative discussions with MDs to verify the clinical rationale behind billed procedures. Communicate effectively while building trust and lasting partnerships both laterally and vertically across multi-discipline teams. Communicate effectively both internally and externally to ensure accurate claims adjudication and proper provider notification. Success in this role looks like: By the end of your initial 90-day period, you will have demonstrated a strong understanding of clinical coding practices and medical records review, while assisting our team in areas of DRG validation. By 6 months, you will be working autonomously to execute within our clinical review workflows and will have developed strong interpersonal relationships across the organization. The CDM works on multi-functional teams and supports clinical trial projects as a departmental subject matter expert (SME). We are seeking a temporary clinical data manager who can dedicate 20 hours a week to support ongoing study activities. jobs.title: Pharmacist
jobs.description: The Order Management Associate (Pharmacist) provide support in acknowledgment of orders and documentation support to the Order Management team. This role focuses on acknowledgment logging, data organization, and encoding assistance to ensure smooth workflow and timely order processing. Essential Functions A. Order Encoding and Documentation Support Receive and organize incoming prescriptions and orders files. Ensure prescriptions are properly labeled and stored in digital folders. Maintain organized tracking logs of all incoming orders. Encode approved orders into designated systems (Compounder, trackers, OneDrive). Prepare and organize prescription files (soft and hard copies). Assist in backlog clearance during peak volume day. Prepares other task requires in order management. B. Order Acknowledgment Support Assist in acknowledging orders across platforms under guidance of Order Management Specialist II. Flag incomplete or unclear orders for review Ensure acknowledgment logs are updated in real time. C. Administrative and Reporting Support Assist in preparing weekly OMD reports. Update trackers, dashboards, and monitoring files. Ensure documentation completeness before handover to QA & Logistics. D. Cross Functional Assistance Perform other operationally required tasks assigned by heads. Adhere to company standards and policies at all times.

jobs.title: Roving Clinic Nurse
jobs.description: About the role Remedy Skintech, Inc. is seeking an experienced Roving Clinic Nurse to join our dynamic team in Metro Manila. As a Roving Clinic Nurse, you will play a crucial role in providing high-quality nursing care and support to our patients in an aesthetic clinic setting. What you'll be doing Deliver high-quality laser procedures to our patients Assist on doctors' procedures In charge of post-op procedures like equipment maintenance patients' post-treatment protocols Undergo training for all Remedy treatments Collaborating with the team to coordinate patient care and facilitate a smooth patient experience Providing patient education and promoting healthy behaviours to support positive health outcomes Maintaining a clean, safe, and well-organised clinical environment What we offer At Remedy Skintech, Inc., we value our employees and strive to create a supportive, collaborative work environment. As a Roving Clinic Nurse, you can expect competitive salary, and opportunities for professional development and career advancement. About us Remedy Skintech, Inc. is a leading provider of advanced dermatological services and skincare products in the Philippines. Our mission is to empower individuals to achieve their healthiest, most radiant skin through innovative treatments and personalized care. With a team of experienced medical professionals and a state-of-the-art facility, we are dedicated to delivering exceptional patient outcomes and an unparalleled customer experience. If you're passionate about nursing and committed to making a difference in the lives of our patients, we encourage you to apply for this exciting opportunity.
